objectives: Read and compare taught ou word families in controlled phrases and text.

concepts: ou represents /ou/ in the taught word set.
A vowel team is read as a unit while consonants are blended.
Readers check the complete word and its meaning rather than relying on a first-letter guess.
Fresh examples help show transfer beyond memorised responses.

workedExamples.prompt: Read “cloud”. Which spelling is the target focus?
workedExamples.solution: The target spelling is ou; read the whole word using the taught sound /ou/.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner misreads “shout”. What should be checked?
workedExamples.solution: Identify ou, blend the complete word and reread to check the taught pronunciation.

workedExamples.prompt: Why try a fresh example after guided practice?
workedExamples.solution: A new item checks whether the learner can use the skill independently.
